in_marathi.name: Rudrappa
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rudrappa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rudrappa is a combination of Rudra and Appa. Rudra is the name of Lord Shiva, the god of destruction, while Appa is the Kannada word for father. Therefore, Rudrappa means 'Father of Lord Shiva'.
